top_signals.title: Secretary Wright on Diesel Shortage, Gas Prices, Oil Shipping
top_signals.summary: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright talks about the sharp rise in diesel and gasoline prices and what the Trump administration is doing to bring them down. He also talks about converting dark fleet ships into legitimate oil tankers. He speaks to Bloomberg's Annmarie Hordern at a Citadel Securities event in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
